Maya Chen: Heads up — Artemis QBR scheduled for Wed May 3 (10am PT). I want to ship a 1-page exec summary + a short deck. Quick ask: owners for exec one-pager, onboarding status slide, renewal risk heatmap, enablement gaps + sample playbook, and any customer quotes. I'll own the exec one-pager draft. Can people volunteer?

Liam O'Connor: I'll take exec slide + metrics. Need latest ARR by product and DAU by workspace. @Sarah Patel can you drop activation funnel and SSO/GA issues?

Sarah Patel: Onboarding snapshot: 62% completed (n=470). Top blockers: 1) SSO config failing for 3 customers, 2) dataset import errors for sandbox, 3) missing 'getting started' guide in self-serve. I'll paste quick notes:
```
- Completed: 470 / 761
- In progress: 189
- Blockers: SSO(3), import(5), docs(1)
- Recommended: SSO healthcheck script + doc PR
```

Jordan Rivera: Renewal signal = amber. Surface reasons: usage plateau last 14d, 2 escalations open (import + rate limits), CSM asks for targeted onboarding workshop. Prob churn ~18% per model. Proposed mitigations:
- schedule SM-led workshop
- add import pre-check to onboarding
- offer 1 month trial of Dedicated capacity (discount)
I'll draft slide.

Maya Chen: Perfect. I'll consolidate. Draft plan and owners:
```
- Exec one-pager: Maya Chen
- Metrics & finance slide: Liam O'Connor
- Onboarding status: Sarah Patel
- Renewal risk + mitigation: Jordan Rivera
- Enablement playbook + sample: Open (volunteer?)
- Slides filename: ARTEMIS_QBR_V1.pptx
- Deadline: Tue EOD (May 2)
```

Liam O'Connor: I can add the enablement playbook sample (short checklist + SLOs). Will link numbers by EOD Mon.

Sarah Patel: I'll attach the SSO logs and CI link in here in a sec. Also adding two customer quotes from last week.

Maya Chen: calendar-bot scheduled the QBR and sent invites. Also please add any asks to the action tracker: https://docs.redwood.ai/qbr-artemis/rt-action-tracker. Drop :thumbsup: if you're set.
